title: Types and conversions
description:
Complete the static methods in `Solution`:

```csharp
public static double ToCelsius(double fahrenheit)          // (F - 32) * 5 / 9
public static double Average(int a, int b, int c)          // the exact average: Average(1, 2, 2) is 1.666...
public static int ParseOrDefault(string text, int fallback) // the number in text, or fallback if it is not a whole number
public static decimal TotalPrice(decimal unitPrice, int quantity, decimal taxRate)
```

`TotalPrice` is `unitPrice * quantity`, plus tax at `taxRate` (0.2 means 20 %), rounded to 2 decimals with halves rounded **away from zero**.
hints: `(a + b + c) / 3` divides two `int`s, which cuts off the fraction before it ever becomes a `double`. Make one side a double: `3.0`.
`int.TryParse(text, out int value)` returns `false` instead of throwing; `Math.Round(x, 2, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero)` rounds 0.125 up to 0.13.
